title: Juicy Light German Smoked Salmon Pasta
description: A buttery and light German dish featuring smoked salmon, perfect for a weeknight dinner, with a bhuna twist and raw-friendly ingredients.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the fettuccine pasta according to package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter over medium heat.
Add the bhuna spice mix to the skillet and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the sliced smoked salmon to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Stir in the chopped fresh parsley, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Drain the cooked fettuccine pasta and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the salmon and spice mixture.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of unsalted butter to the skillet and toss to combine.
Serve the pasta hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
